opportunities.title: [Bounty] Record the real network fee in the ledger, not only the capped estimate
opportunities.description:
### 赏金平台 / Platform
GitHub

### 原始链接 / Source URL
https://github.com/Grainlify/grainlify-bounty-agent/issues/1

### 漏洞描述 / Description
Record the real network fee in the ledger, not only the capped estimate

**The problem**

When the agent pays for inference over x402, the Solana network fee is most of what the call costs — in our measurements a paid call cost $0.002031, of which $0.002004 was the network fee. So the fee is the number most worth getting right.

The signer already knows exactly what the fee was: `res.feeLamports`, taken from the confirmed transaction. It converts that to micro-USD using `solUsdCeilingPrice`, a deliberately high fixed SOL price ($400) chosen so the budget can never under-count spend.

That conversion is the only thing kept. `inference_calls` stores `fee_micro` and no lamports, so the ledger reports a conservative estimate and the exact figure is thrown away.

**Where in the code**

- `services/signer/src/signer.ts` — `PayResult` carries `fee_lamports`; look for `lamportsToMicroCeil(res.feeLamports, ...)`.
- `packages/x402/src/client.ts` — the settle call that records the payment drops `fee_lamports`.
- `db/migrations/` — add a new forward-only migrat

opportunities.description:
Owner: @hulh122. Areas: billing, subscriptions, usage packs, and credits; IM integrations (Slack, Discord, Feishu, Telegram, Teams, AgentPhone).

## Why

This is part of the API transaction reduction effort. The goal is fewer transactions, no `db` or `tx` handles passed between functions, and in the end only a few small transactions, each inside one command that does not pass `tx` on. At main `22f4f73d85f180ad2555f5178b5f5ddf403c943f`, production `signals/services` and `signals/routes` contain 418 transaction call sites. About 82% of them (341) pass `tx` to other functions, and about 1,900 parameters are typed as database handles. The scope is split by maintainer, using `git blame` on each transaction line and July–September commit activity. Sibling issues: #37510 (Linghan: billing, IM), #37511 (Lancy: workflow automation, Pi memory, storage), #37512 (Qiqi: connectors, remote access), #37513 (Ethan: chat runs, user/org lifecycle).

## Scope (121 transaction call sites in 51 files)

Shape breakdown (heuristic scan of each callback body): passes tx 96, inline multi-statement 15, single statement 6, needs manual check 4. Line numbers are from `22f4f73`.

A review of the 74 existing tickets found that nothing owns the core of the product: **choosing and testing the actual trading / prediction algorithms.** The completed #70–#75, #111, #119–#128 work builds market-state descriptors (EWMA, CUSUM, Kalman, PELT, BOCPD, ATR, PCA, correlation, HMM, mark/trade, OI/funding, taker flow). ## Goal

Extend the existing observer-first evaluation work in #20 into a reproducible tournament for local tool-calling/orchestration policies, then test whether Agent0-style self-evolution can improve the winning local policy on our own traces.

Runtime inventory/control belongs in https://github.com/kvnloo/z0intelligence/issues/20. Evolution Lab owns grouped experiments, frozen evaluation, training/search, and promotion evidence.
